takeaways.text: High-bandwidth memory for AI servers brought in $3.4B at a 58% gross margin — already Micron's largest business unit, and by far its most profitable per dollar of sales.
takeaways.title: Cloud Memory leads

takeaways.text: Gross margin hit 38%, up from 27% a year ago — with AI memory in short supply, higher prices fall almost straight through to profit. Non-GAAP gross margin was 39%.
takeaways.title: Margins widened

takeaways.text: Net income rose to $1.9B from $332M a year ago, and Micron guided the next quarter's revenue to $10.7B as the AI build-out accelerated.
takeaways.title: Profit jumped five-fold

verdict: Micron's revenue rose 37% to $9.3B as AI demand for its memory chips kept booming — gross margin widened to 38% and net income jumped to $1.9B, more than five times a year ago.
